question: Under what condition does poison not enter the body, even in the case of a bite?
premises: A person may be bitten by great serpents.
Even in that case, poison does not enter the body.
This is stated as a general result.
inference: Even if bitten by great serpents, poison does not enter the body.
plain_english: Poison does not enter the body, even if one has been bitten by great serpents.
